blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Bicol Saro party-list Rep. Terry Ridon has offered tissue paper to critics who cannot get over the Senate Impeachment Court’s ruling allowing a lower minimum vote to convict Vice President Sara Duterte, so they can wipe their tears away. In a press briefing on Thursday at the Batasang Pambansa complex, Ridon, a member of the public prosecution team, said that those who think that the impeachment court was manipulated can use his tissue to dry their tears. “Siguro pang huling remarks na lang ho doon sa mga nagsasabi na this is manipulated and kung ano pa man ho […]...
